other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be studying in a recognized university in India or abroad.
Applicant must have secured at least 60% marks in the last degree or certificate examination.

Applicant must qualify as any one of the following: completed or pursuing a Diploma; completed or pursuing Graduation/Bachelor’s/Engineering; completed or pursuing an Integrated/Dual Degree/Master/Post Graduate degree.
Applications must be sponsored/forwarded by the Sponsoring Institution where the applicant is currently enrolled or has recently passed out.
A candidate can avail the internship only once with NIELIT.
A minimum of 80% attendance is required in a month to receive the stipend and certificate.
Preference will be given to candidates with exposure in the area of intended internship, good academic background, and higher qualifications based on need.
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹5,000 per month for S&T interns or ₹3,000 per month for non‑S&T interns, along with a certificate upon successful completion.
documents_required: Application with brief write‑up stating the reason for applying
Endorsement/recommendation letter from the sponsoring institution
